page.content:
Aang's Fire Nation-born predecessor.

How Avatar Roku connects

  • Concept: Avatar cycle — Roku is the Avatar before Aang.
  • Faction: Fire Nation — Roku was born in the Fire Nation before becoming Avatar.

What is Avatar Roku?

Avatar Roku is the Avatar before Aang, a Fire Nation noble who failed to stop Sozin and later guides Aang from the spirit world.
